title: Deep learning screen of 700,000 compounds finds anti-SARS-CoV-2 inhibitors
summary: A structure-based activity model screened about 700,000 compounds and the top 100 were tested: 19 were active in Caco-2 cells and eight showed dose-dependent activity in Vero cells (EC50 1 to 7 uM). Clustering pointed to nucleoside analogs; azathioprine and its metabolite thioinosinic acid were active in vitro, and thioinosinic acid also reduced viral loads in mouse lungs. Mouse design details are not given in the abstract.
ai_technology: Deep learning predictive model of compound activity from structural features, plus clustering

evidence.tested: In vitro assays in Caco-2 and Vero cells and viral load in mouse lungs.
evidence.unknown: Mouse numbers, dosing and clinical relevance are not stated; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Screened roughly 700,000 compounds and selected candidates for testing.
